config.notes: Torrens course pages (www.torrens.edu.au/courses/<area>/<slug>), one course per page, server-rendered, no page JSON. Key-facts panel: "Study mode", "Campus locations*", "Course duration", "Start date DD Mon YYYY ..." (dated starts, shared by domestic/international view; central calendar https://www.torrens.edu.au/how-to-apply/key-dates, Main Intakes 1-4 = Feb, May/Jun, Sep, Nov), "This is an AQF Level N course". English: international Admission criteria tab, "Academic IELTS 6.5 (no band less than 6.0)" - last IELTS on page is the international one. Fee NOT on course pages (points to international course fee schedule PDF); no fee pattern. Index/hub pages bound to several courses (higher-degrees-by-research, graduate-diploma-of-education, master-of-education-advanced) must not be admitted.
